Prove it: `cargo package -p caliper-docgen-semantic --allow-dirty --no-verify` into a scratch dir (or `cargo package --list` to see what ships), unpack under /tmp/claude-501/pkg-semantic/, run `cargo test --lib` there (offline if possible) and show it no longer panics; also run the workspace test. Gates by exit code: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-semantic --no-fail-fast`, `just test-checker-lane` (outside the sandbox, no CARGO_TARGET_DIR).
